did: Built the some-ui half of the interview essay. It has a format of its own, beside the Rust Rounds essay's. It plays on the same essay stage, and the same recorder records either one; a sample essay recorded locally to a four-and-a-half-minute video with both takes. The Monday routine now writes the essay itself. Code measures each take, draws the faults over the weeks and checks each quote against the transcript, and the model writes only the judged parts and the words said. The mailbox takes the essay's file, and the ledger holds its two tables and its outcome, proved by the server's tests. Also fixed the routine's setup on a fresh clone, and a slow burn-ins test that a busier CI run pushed past its time limit.
